test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 01 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which Indian state topped the 'Environment' theme in the State of States rankings of the State of India’s Environment 2025 report released by the Centre for Science and Environment (CSE)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Andhra Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the **State of India's Environment 2025** report released by the **Centre for Science and Environment (CSE)**, **Andhra Pradesh** secured the **top position in the 'Environment' theme** among Indian states.
 
• The rankings evaluate states based on various environmental indicators, including **forest and tree cover, air quality, water resource management, waste management, biodiversity conservation, and climate action**.
 
• The report aims to assess the environmental performance of states and encourage sustainable development and effective environmental governance.
 
• The **State of States** rankings are a part of the annual **State of India's Environment** report published by the Centre for Science and Environment.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **Option 1 – Andhra Pradesh**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Centre for Science and Environment (CSE):**

 
 
• It is a **New Delhi-based public interest research and advocacy organisation** working on environmental issues.
 
• It was founded in **1980** by **Anil Agarwal**.
 
• **Sunita Narain** is the Director General of CSE.
 
 
 
• **State of India's Environment Report:**
 
 
• It is published annually by the **Centre for Science and Environment (CSE)**.
 
• The report covers themes related to **environment, agriculture, public health, forests, water, climate change, and sustainable development**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Report:** State of India's Environment 2025.
 
• **Released By:** Centre for Science and Environment (CSE).
 
• **Top State in 'Environment' Theme:** **Andhra Pradesh**.
 
• **CSE Headquarters:** New Delhi.
 
• **Founder of CSE:** **Anil Agarwal**.
 
• **Director General:** **Sunita Narain**.
